title: fix(metadata-protocol, runtime)!: refuse navigationContributions on a package created at runtime
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DQwjrFVgyyoUSKB2w2w7kZf)_

Fixes #30072

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `POST /api/v1/packages` (both install limbs, the no-protocol fallback included) and the protocol install primitive `installPackage` (so the package duplicate and every in-process caller too) refuse a manifest whose `navigationContributions` is a non-empty list with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, where they stored it and answered `201` before. Widened: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` publishes one new export, `runtimeNavigationContributionsRefusal`, the predicate both doors ask (the shape `customizationPairManifestRefusal` already has).
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #30711

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:运行时新建包(Studio、REST、MCP、AI 调 `POST /api/v1/packages`)如果带 `navigationContributions`,现在直接拒绝(400),不再存下来;代码包的菜单贡献照旧生效。
- 为什么改:这种包的菜单贡献从来不会注册,服务器却回「成功」,重启后也不出现,AI 会告诉用户「已加好菜单」。按裁决 A:响亮拒绝,并指出两条能走通的路(应用覆盖进定制包;贡献写进代码包)。
- 风险与回滚:只收窄运行时建包入口;已存进 `sys_packages` 的旧包照常加载(其菜单本来就不生效)。示例与 HotCRM 只在代码包里用这个键,不受影响。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-install.ts`(判定函数与原语里的调用点)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`(入口在两条安装分支之前、409 之前询问)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-install-navigation-contributions.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-install-navigation-contributions.test.ts`,预期 10 个用例全过(两条分支各 5 个:拒绝、裸清单拒绝、先于 409、无键或空数组放行、代码包贡献照常)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`runtimeNavigationContributionsRefusal(manifest)`** (new, `protocol-package-install.ts`, exported from the package entry): `undefined` when the manifest carries no `navigationContributions` or an empty list; otherwise the refusal sentence. It names the key and the package, and both routes that work: an override of the app in its customization package for a customer's own menu (ADR-0146 D2, what Studio's navigation editor writes), and a code package for a contribution into another package's app.
- **The install primitive** (`installPackage`) asks it right after the whole-manifest declaration parse, so a malformed manifest keeps the declaration's located answer, and before every write and every server-state read. It throws with `statusCode: 400`, which an HTTP boundary answers as `VALIDATION_ERROR`. Every caller passes here: the HTTP door's composed limb, `duplicatePackage` (a base stored with the key before this change is now refused on duplicate, by the rethrow rule that refuses a duplicate whose record is refused), and an embedder.
- **`POST /api/v1/packages`** asks the same predicate after the whole-body verdict and ahead of the duplicate-id `409`, so both install limbs are judged (the no-protocol fallback writes the registry directly and never reaches the primitive) and the answer does not depend on whether the id is installed.
- **No new error code.** A request-shape refusal at an install door is a validation refusal; the ledger's rule sends a generic condition to the standard catalog, and the door's sibling refusals (`id`, `version`, whole body, customization pair) all answer `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`. Nothing in `packages/spec` moves.

## Why

On `main` the runtime door stored `navigationContributions` and answered `201`, but only `ObjectQL.registerApp` (the door a code package takes at boot, from the marketplace or on an artifact reload) registers contributions. `SchemaRegistry.installPackage`, which the runtime install and the `sys_packages` replay at boot both use, registers none, so the entry never appeared, not after a restart either. The maintainer ruled option A on the card (record 6631177389), verbatim: 「…其他全部同意」 — refuse the key loudly and name the working routes.

**Doors enumerated.** Every runtime door that stores a manifest: `POST /api/v1/packages` (both limbs) and the protocol primitive (with its in-process callers: `duplicatePackage`, `ensureCustomizationPackage`, which builds its own manifest without the key, and the unmanaged install's base, which carries identity keys only and whose plan already refuses `navigationContributions` as `422 UNMANAGED_INSTALL_UNCOPYABLE`). `PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id` accepts only `name`, `description`, `version` and `dependencies`, so it never stores the key. Marketplace installs and code packages go through `registerApp`, which registers contributions, and are untouched.

**ADR-0087 disposition:** `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, in the changeset. No key of any schema is added, removed or renamed; `ManifestSchema.navigationContributions` keeps its shape and meaning for code packages. A refused contribution never reached any app's navigation, so there is no rewrite that keeps what the author meant: the author takes one of the two routes the refusal names. First-party users of the key, measured: `examples/app-multi-package` (`orders` module) and HotCRM (its artifact modules) use it only in code packages, which register through `registerApp`; the platform's own users (Setup capability plugins, `cloud-connection`, `mcp`, `plugin-approvals`) are code packages too. Rows already in `sys_packages` are data at rest and replay as stored.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.install-navigation-contributions.test.ts`: the primitive refuses (envelope `400` / `VALIDATION_ERROR` via `resolveThrownHttpError`, neither the registry write nor the durable `publish` ran); the sentence's first clause and the two routes; a malformed manifest keeps the declaration's answer first; lit controls (no key, empty list) install.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-install-navigation-contributions.test.ts`, on both the composed and the no-protocol arm, over a real `ObjectQL` engine and protocol: refusal with the ADR-0112 envelope (`code`, `status`, `ApiErrorSchema` parse) and nothing stored (`GET` answers `404`); the bare-manifest body form; refused ahead of the `409`; lit controls; and a code package's contribution registered through `registerApp` is still served and untouched by the refusal.

Ablation, one per guarded behaviour, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob changed, restored to the `HEAD` blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`; both suites import the source, so no `dist/` leg):

- the door's guard (`navRefusal !== undefined` → `&& false`) turned the runtime suite red, `5 failed | 5 passed`: all four fallback-arm refusal cases, plus the composed arm's "ahead of the 409" case (the 409 answers first without it).
- the primitive's guard, the same mutation, turned the primitive suite red, `1 failed | 3 passed`: the refusal case.

## Acceptance notes

- An empty `navigationContributions: []` installs: it promises nothing and registers nothing.
- A writable base stored with the key before this change cannot be duplicated until it is reinstalled without the key (`POST /api/v1/packages` with `overwrite: true`); `PATCH` cannot remove a manifest key. The refusal on duplicate is the same sentence.
- The refusal text is not pinned beyond its first clause and its two route names.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
